title: Optimize a warehouse: loads, data types, statistics and result set caching
objective_text: Choose the load pattern, column types and features that keep a Fabric Warehouse fast, and say why.
scenario: Brightwater's finance warehouse feeds a dashboard that's getting slow. The nightly load inserts rows one at a time, some columns are much wider than their data, and the same dashboard query runs all day.
verifies: You can pick the right setting or pattern for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can apply it in Fabric: nothing is set up or run here. Doing it on a real item is FABRIC VERIFIED work.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.

explanation: Each question's answer, reason and source page are shown after a pass or on request.
